policy.source_layer: source.json and items.tsv are immutable accepted source projections.
policy.mechanical_layer: mechanical-cross-reference-r1.json records current candidates and the preserved runtime crosswalk but contains no expert decisions.
policy.expert_layer: This file owns terminal corpus review decisions and keeps runtime representation separate from duplicate identity.
policy.runtime_crosswalk_boundary: PR #121 establishes implementation and lexical coverage only; it does not automatically validate source readings, glosses, segmentation, category, naturalness, or corpus duplicate identity.
policy.source_claim_boundary: Register labels, generic negation prose, and the lesson phonics heading remain source claims requiring independent evidence.
policy.evidence_boundary: Pedagogical attestation does not establish productivity, frequency, construction identity, dialect-wide naturalness, preferred Jyutping, parser correctness, or status.
